title: 黑石360亿：芯片融资，能否超越Apollo纪录？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Blackstone holding early talks with investors to gauge interest in a second mega debt package to finance andthropics use of chips from Google.
segments.zh: 黑石集团正与市场参与者进行早期洽谈，评估市场对第二笔巨额债务融资的兴趣，该融资旨在支持Anthropic使用谷歌的芯片。

segments.en: The potential new round of financing comes on the heels of Anthropics Confidential IPO filing. Emily Grafeo has been writing about this and she joins us now.
segments.zh: 在Anthropic秘密提交IPO申请后，这笔潜在的新融资轮次随之而来。Emily Grafeo对此进行了报道，现在她加入我们。

segments.en: So what do we know? What do we not know about this right now?
segments.zh: 那么我们现在对此了解多少？又有哪些未知？

segments.en: So one thing we know, Scarlet, is that this is very early on in the stages of Blackstone pitching this to investors. We actually don't know really the true size and structure of this deal.
segments.zh: Scarlet，我们知道的一点是，黑石向市场参与者推销这一方案仍处于非常早期的阶段。实际上，我们并不清楚这笔交易的真实规模和结构。

segments.en: We know that Blackstone had held early discussions with investors.
segments.zh: 我们知道黑石已与市场参与者进行了初步讨论。

segments.en: The number 36 billion was floated. So what they're trying to do here is get credit funding
segments.zh: 有消息称金额为360亿美元。他们试图通过信贷融资来帮助Anthropic建设AI基础设施，购买和租赁芯片。

segments.en: to help andthropic build out its AI infrastructure, to buy and to lease chips.
segments.zh: 我们知道芯片非常昂贵，今年到目前为止，大部分资金都用于数据中心融资，现在我们正转向芯片融资。

segments.en: We know that chips are very expensive and a lot of the funding so far this year has been data center of financing and now we're kind of pivoting to chip financing.
segments.zh: 如果这笔360亿美元的交易成行，那将是史上最大规模的私人信贷融资，超过我们几周前报道的350亿美元Apollo主导的芯片融资。

segments.en: So if we actually did see a $36 billion deal, that would be the largest private credit financing on record. It would be larger than the $35 billion appalo led chip financing that
segments.zh: 这告诉我们AI建设处于什么阶段？你提到芯片而非数据中心。

segments.en: we reported about a couple weeks ago. What does it tell us about the stage of AI build out that we're in? I mean you mentioned chips as opposed to data centers.
segments.zh: 我们几周前报道过。这说明了AI建设处于什么阶段？我指的是芯片，而不是数据中心。

segments.en: Right. Yeah, so appalo and Broadcom and Anthropic had announced a couple weeks ago that they're trying to build 20 gigawatts of compute capacity. The $35 billion deal,
segments.zh: 对，Appalo、博通和Anthropic几周前宣布，计划建设20吉瓦的计算能力。这笔350亿美元的交易是针对1吉瓦的。

segments.en: that was for one gigawatt. So what we know is that there's going to be a lot more compute capacity
segments.zh: 所以我们知道，未来会有更多的计算能力。
